limits: Chromium desktop/mobile viewport checks, not physical devices or a complete accessibility audit.
Per-page navigation verifies visible desktop navigation or a visible mobile trigger; actual scoped sidebar-link interaction is tested on the context overview at each viewport, not every menu branch.
External HTTP requests blocked; external link availability is outside this local rendering sweep.
All rendered context-page fragments checked against DOM; other internal targets receive HTTP-status checks only.
Screenshots require separate human/model visual inspection; this JSON does not claim that inspection.
No application source mutation, provider call, user session or public server.
